## Design

### 2026-10-07 — So ikik i was supposed to do the pcb design but i figured out that if i started off with the pcb i wouldnt know the dimensions of the pcb so i did the design scheme first and figured out what all im g

**1.73h**

So ikik i was supposed to do the pcb design but i figured out that if i started off with the pcb i wouldnt know the dimensions of the pcb so i did the design scheme first and figured out what all im gonna be needing :
So i worked on the design anol that stuff i also did the BOM but im too sleepy rn to journal all of that so im gonna cover that in the next journal and i also figured out all the aligning of all the parts in the design
Other than the timelapse I also researched and sourced all the parts im gonna need :
I found about 3 to 4 options for a 360 degree good lidar in India ; one was the Slamtec rplidar series, ydlidar, and the ldrobot , the rest were either too costly or not good so i decided to use the LDROBOT STL-27L for this its compact very light weight and draws significantly less power compared to the others making it more suitable as a wearable than the other lidars and for the main processing and mapping im gonna use a raspi 5 compute module as the main processor that takes in the lidar input anol and maps evrything , for displaying everything im gonna be using a module like the Waveshare 7inch QLED Capacitive Touch Dot Display 1024×600 Supports Various Systems in this entry i havent added it in the design yet but ill prolly do it by the next entry i also figured using a imu like the Adafruit 9-DOF Orientation IMU Fusion Breakout - BNO085 (BNO080) - STEMMA QT /Qwiic for motion detection  for mapping anol ill be starting with the main pcb by the next entry
